title: Collect children from a handler
summary: SIGCHLD tells the parent that a child ended; waitpid(-1, ..., WNOHANG) in a loop collects them all.
hints: Several children can end while only one `SIGCHLD` is delivered, so the handler must loop: `while (waitpid(-1, NULL, WNOHANG) > 0) reaped++;`.
In the parent wait with `while (reaped < n) sleep(1);`: a signal wakes `sleep` early, and if the signal came first the sleep just takes a second.
